mapper.select: SELECT d.cl_code AS "clCode", g.cl_code_nm AS "clCodeNm", d.code AS "code", d.code_nm AS "codeNm", d.sort_ordr AS "sortOrdr", d.use_yn AS "useYn" FROM comtccmmncodedetail d JOIN comtccmmnclcode g ON g.cl_code=d.cl_code ORDER BY d.cl_code, d.sort_ordr

SELECT e.emplyr_id AS "emplyrId", e.user_nm AS "userNm", e.email_adres AS "emailAdres", e.ofcps_nm AS "ofcpsNm", e.dept_code AS "deptCode", e.emplyr_sttus AS "emplyrSttus", e.lock_at AS "lockAt", to_char(e.last_login_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "lastLoginDt", (SELECT string_agg(author_code, ',') FROM comtnempauthor a WHERE a.emplyr_id=e.emplyr_id) AS "roles" FROM comtnemplyrinfo e ORDER BY e.emplyr_id
